overview: The committee discussed zoning amendments requiring monthly reporting from short-term rental platforms and initiated a comprehensive review of the city's fee schedule. Both matters were advanced with requests for reports and feedback from city departments and legal counsel.

items.title: Short-Term Rental Ordinance Reporting Amendments
items.summary: Referred draft zoning language to the building commissioner, IT director, and Planning, Development, and Sustainability director for a 60-day review to establish mandatory monthly platform reporting on short-term rentals.

items.title: City Fee Schedule Review
items.summary: Voted to request 90-day department reports on fee schedules, climate and housing incentive alignments, and legal authority, while also requesting a legal opinion from KP Law on tying municipal fees to inflation.
